newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nisshin Oil to close canola crushing plant in Kobe.
newsitem.headline: Nisshin Oil to close canola crushing plant in Kobe.

text.p: Nisshin Oil Mills Ltd said on Tuesday it will close a canola crushing plant in Kobe, western Japan, as of end March 1998. The plant has the capacity to crush about 120,000 tonnes of canola a year.
The firm plans to boost the crushing capacity of another plant near Tokyo to offset the losses of the Kobe facility, a company spokesman said. "Total crushing capacity will not change," he added.
Nisshin Oil Mills is Japan's largest edible oil producer and currently has the capacity to crush 1.26 million tonnes of oilseeds per year.
